newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real closes up 0.01 pct in bland trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real closes up 0.01 pct in bland trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0200 against the dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market amid languid trade due in part to a limited strike by bank workers, dealers said.
Although the strike did not succeed in closing banks, it did slow operations which constrained market activity, dealers said.
Traders said the market was still expecting another decline in the dollar-real mini-band, of at least 0.1 percent, before the end of the month.
The current trade level was set on Wednesday between 1.020 and 1.025 reais per greenback.
In the interbank forex floating rate market, the real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0257 to the dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real ended flat at 1.038 per greenback, traders said.
